title: Code and data for: Sharp residual certificates for projector iterates on the Grassmann manifold under numerical perturbations
description: Code, data and scripts that reproduce every table and figure of the manuscript Sharp residual certificates for projector iterates on the Grassmann manifold under numerical perturbations (P. Kubwimana, B. P. Reddy, J. M. Mkenyeleye), submitted to Quaestiones Mathematicae. See the folder certificate and its README. The folders matlab, python and results belong to the related preprint (doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-10428281/v1).
